thread:
olivia (sales): Heads-up: BeaconCorp wants a 48hr POC next week. Requirements: ephemeral Dedicated pool, 6 reserved GPUs + burst to 14 for two 90-min demo periods, rotated hosted API key with IP allowlist, and option to do VPC peering if security signs off. Need quick feasibility and a rough cost so I can confirm with the customer.

raj (solutions): Model? sequence lengths? Any special latency SLO for the public demo?

olivia (sales): Model: opt-30b-8bit, typical seq 512 but occasional 2048 during long-context demos. They expect <250ms median latency during demo windows. Public demo link will be used by ~80 concurrent users at peak.

mateo (eng-runtime): opt-30b-8bit at 2048 is heavy. For <250ms median we should pre-warm some slots. Proposal: reserved=6 + prewarm_slots=4 (kept warm during demo hours) + burst_max=14, burst_window=1.5h twice per day. Also enable KV cache + batching. Recommend pinning to model v1.3 and disable any live model rollouts.

sophia (eng-infra): Infra can do ephemeral pool and pre-warmed slots. We treat prewarm as reserved but billed at a lower prewarm rate if used only during scheduled windows. Need exact demo windows and CIDR list if peering. Also: autoscale cooldown 3m, drain grace 90s.

anya (security): For peering: require security questionnaire and their network SOC contact. If they choose IP allowlist instead, we'll issue ephemeral API key with 72h TTL and restrict key to Acme demo route. Also need to run a brief vuln scan of any demo assets hosted on our infra.

olivia (sales): Demo windows: Apr 6 16:0017:30 UTC and Apr 7 15:0016:30 UTC. They prefer peering but will accept IP allowlist to move faster. I'll ask for network contact.

mateo (eng-runtime): Two runtime knobs I want enabled: 1) cost/protection throttle that aborts new burst allocations if forecasted token cost > $500/hr; 2) canary fallback to opt-13b-quant if queue > 60s. Both reversible via console.

olivia (sales): Can finance give a price range?

derek (finance): Quick back-of-envelope: reserved 6 GPUs for 2 days = ~288 GPU-hrs reserved, prewarm 4 slots for ~3h total = ~12 GPU-hrs prewarm, potential burst (if fully used) up to additional 168 GPU-hrs. Very rough incremental cost $6k$12k depending on actual burst. I can issue a provisional demo invoice and a $3k overage buffer if needed.

raj (solutions): I'll draft a minimal runbook and commands. Proposed CLI for infra create: 

```
rictl pool create \ 
  --name beaconcorp-poc-apr \ 
  --reserved 6 \ 
  --prewarm 4 \ 
  --burst-max 14 \ 
  --burst-window "90m" \ 
  --schedule "2026-04-06T16:00Z/2026-04-07T17:00Z" \ 
  --rbac "team:beacon-poc" \ 
  --notes "48hr POC: prewarm slots + burst; rotated key; IP allowlist/peering TBD"
```

raj (solutions): Also will add monitor alerts (latency > 300ms, queue > 60s, token cost > $600/hr) and a short checklist for dry-run.

ticket-bot: created INFRA-POC-4999 assigned to sophia (eng-infra)

sophia (eng-infra): Opening infra ticket and will provision once we have: final schedule, IP allowlist or peering decision, security questionnaire status, and finance approval for buffer (noted). ETA to provision: 48hrs after inputs.

anya (security): I'll post the questionnaire here. If they want peering, we need answers + signed terms 72hrs before scheduled demo.

derek (finance): Approving $3k buffer for overage. Please escalate if we hit >$6k.

olivia (sales): Thanks team. Action items: I'll collect network contact and CIDR by EOD, confirm peering vs IP allowlist, and get customer to sign AUP if peering. Raj, please prepare runbook. Sophia, proceed after inputs.

mateo (eng-runtime): One more note: enable token-level tracing and a manual kill switch exposed to the sales lead for the demo session.

olivia (sales): Perfect. Aim to have infra ready by 2026-04-04 for dry-run. Will update thread. :rocket:
